sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा वन्दमानं तु सीता शशिनिभानना ।अब्रवीद्दीर्घमुच्छ्वस्य वानरं मधुरस्वरा ।।। ५.३४.१३।।।।
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā vandamānaṁ tu sītā śaśinibhānanā ।abravīddīrghamucchvasya vānaraṁ madhurasvarā ।।। 5.34.13।।।।

translations.english: On seeing the vanara prostrated, the moonfaced lady, sighed deeply and spoke to him in a sweet voice:
